title: US intel warns Putin is planning a NATO attack: What we know
summary: CNN report on US intelligence that Putin may test NATO with a limited attack on the Baltics or Poland, with a skeptical view of Russia's spare military capacity.

assertions.quote: Russian President Vladimir Putin could try to test NATO's unity with a limited attack on a NATO

verdicts.note: RAND lists a limited Russian attack on NATO in Europe as a plausible option, motivated by coercing allies to cut aid to Ukraine, but places it among the options Russia is most hesitant to attempt, with no imminent risk as of 2023.
